title: Model Selection Tradeoffs — Local Control or Managed Service
key_insight: Local models offer infrastructure control and predictable data paths. Hosted services reduce operations and may offer stronger models.
body:
## Local Control or Managed Service

Sensitive data cannot leave a controlled network, while another product needs rapid access to frontier quality.

Local models offer infrastructure control and predictable data paths. Hosted services reduce operations and may offer stronger models.

Include licenses, hardware skills, availability, region, and data retention in the decision—not only per-token price.
common_mistakes: Parameter count alone selects the best deployment.
Hosted and local models have identical privacy responsibilities.
A theoretical speedup guarantees lower production tail latency.
mini_exercise: Draw “Local Control or Managed Service” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Real systems choose among local, hosted, small, and large models by workload-specific constraints.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Local Control or Managed Service” to explain Model Selection Tradeoffs plainly.
